# Repository metadata

Applied by the maintainer with `gh` at release time. Not read by any tool.

## Description (GitHub "About", 293 characters)

```
One command installs free Microsoft Office and Adobe alternatives on your Mac (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF editor, Photoshop-style tools) and connects them to Claude Code and Claude Desktop over MCP. Checksum-verified, dry run, one-command uninstall. Apps by Storytold; installer by Qualixar.
```
